faq.q: What are the clinic's opening hours?
faq.a: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Sunday, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Public-holiday hours must be confirmed with reception.

faq.q: Where is NovaCare Medical Centre located?
faq.a: Suite 204, Crescent Plaza, Main Boulevard, F-10 Markaz, Islamabad, Pakistan. The plaza is opposite the F-10 community park entrance.

faq.q: Can I walk in without an appointment?
faq.a: Walk-ins may be accepted if the relevant doctor has capacity. A walk-in is not guaranteed, so requesting an appointment first is recommended.

faq.q: Is my WhatsApp appointment confirmed when I submit the request?
faq.a: No. Aevora records the request for reception. Your appointment is confirmed only after reception explicitly confirms the date and time.

faq.q: How much does a consultation cost?
faq.a: Fees depend on the doctor. Dr Ayesha Rahman: PKR 2,500; Dr Hamza Qureshi: PKR 3,000; Dr Sana Malik: PKR 3,500; Dr Bilal Ahmed: PKR 4,500. Follow-up fees may apply within 7 calendar days as listed in the doctor directory.

faq.q: What payment methods are accepted?
faq.a: The clinic accepts cash, debit cards and credit cards at reception.

faq.q: Does the clinic offer direct insurance billing?
faq.a: No. Direct insurance billing is not currently offered. Ask your insurer whether reimbursement is available.

faq.q: Can I cancel or change an appointment?
faq.a: Contact reception at least 4 hours before the appointment to request a cancellation or change. Aevora can record a request but cannot guarantee the change until reception confirms it.

faq.q: Does NovaCare provide emergency care?
faq.a: No. NovaCare is an outpatient clinic and is not a 24-hour emergency department. For urgent or life-threatening symptoms, seek immediate emergency care and do not wait for a WhatsApp response.

faq.q: Can Aevora diagnose me or recommend medicine?
faq.a: No. Aevora is an administrative receptionist assistant. It can share verified clinic information and help route requests, but it cannot diagnose, prescribe or replace a clinician.

faq.q: Are teleconsultations available?
faq.a: Teleconsultations are not currently listed as an available service. Reception can confirm if this changes.

faq.q: Is parking available?
faq.a: Visitor parking is available in the Crescent Plaza basement, subject to space availability.

faq.q: What should I bring to my visit?
faq.a: Bring any relevant previous prescriptions or reports and arrive 10 minutes before your confirmed appointment. Patients under 18 must attend with a parent or legal guardian.

faq.q: Can you tell me a doctor's live availability?
faq.a: Aevora can share the published clinic schedule, but it cannot see live booking availability. Reception must confirm a specific date and time.

faq.q: What if the clinic is closed on a public holiday?
faq.a: Public-holiday opening can vary. Please confirm with reception; Aevora must not infer holiday opening from the regular weekly schedule.
